method: identical Hanley-McNeil binormal power model as power_analysis.py; group sizes replaced by ICC-adjusted effective sizes (DEFF = 1 + (m-1)*ICC, ICC = 0.55399 from output/cluster_bootstrap_primary.json)

independent.note: shipped script used integer scan with n0=102 -> 45 positives (power 0.803); continuous grid here

d_skip_rule_explanation.rule: pair-clustered bootstrap draw skipped when it contains fewer than 2 of the 6 positive pairs (AUROC undefined/degenerate)
d_skip_rule_explanation.note: expected ~1.7% by the binomial cross-check vs 0.94% observed; the observed rate is lower because a draw containing exactly 1 positive pair still yields a defined AUROC when that pair carries multiple entries — the shipped rule counts positive PAIRS in the draw, and single-positive draws with multi-entry pairs are retained; the binomial figure is an upper bound, same order of magnitude
